items.title: The Ethics of Unpaid Labor and the OSS Community
items.text: An article by Ashe Dryden about how to be able to do unpaid labor for an open source project is a privilege.

items.title: High cohesion, low coupling
items.text: A foundational principle of software development. A lot of other techniques (like SOLID) are just practical applications of this.

items.title: Katas
items.text: A code kata is a programming exercise meant to be repeated over an over in time. Useful as deliberate practice.

items.title: Open Source
items.text: Software that has its source code available, which can in turn be modified and redistributed.

items.title: Survival Tips for Women in Tech
items.text: Distilled wisdom from Patricia Aas, a veteran software developer. A must read if you are a woman working in technology.
